svg.title: Chain arc — nine newly authored two-ended electrical link frames
svg.desc: New semantic vector redraw from a viewed raster reference, not recovered or pixel-identical. Fixed1254 page, nine418 cells, nominal centered anchor209,209. Fixed normalized endpoints0.14,0.54 to0.87,0.54 (58.52,225.72 to363.66,225.72). Two contact caps, branching cream zigzag, green insulation glow and warm discharge fragments evolve independently. Preserve endpoint attachment, not bbox centering. Named frame/contact/link/core/fragment groups. No embedded bitmap, font, script, filter or external resource.
